scope: Private Windows E test archives; the 1.6 and 1.0 720p archives each have one observed physical desktop boot. Other archives require separate physical boot validation.

profiles.name: xbox16-720p-002.zip
profiles.limit: 845 desktop and mouse worked on one physical 1.6 boot; shutdown, repeat boot and persistence remain untested. Earlier 843 shutdown stalled.

profiles.name: xbox10-720p-002.zip
profiles.limit: 846 desktop and Start menu worked on one physical 1.0 boot; user reports return to UnleashX after Windows Restart. No measured display resolution or mouse observation was supplied; power-off, shutdown-log audit, repeat boot and persistence are untested.

profiles.name: xbox10-480p-001.zip
profiles.limit: Hold further 480p package launches pending investigation. 850's sustained red/amber and black screen is consistent with its held display-transaction failure marker before Windows, without identifying the failed operation or proving 847 followed the same path. 851's corrected 0x8a probe responded. Earlier 642 reached interactive 720x480.

profiles.name: xbox10-1080i-002.zip
profiles.limit: Stock E reconstruction was not installer-tested; historical text gaps, motion/drag artifacts and field quality remain unresolved.

profiles.name: xbox10-1024x576-f-002.zip
profiles.limit: Emulator-only 1024x576 desktop, Start and mouse: run015 used a synthetic two-cluster root; exact-ZIP run016 used a normal one-cluster root and showed a Found New Hardware wizard. No physical E boot, shutdown or persistence qualification. Requires the specified 64 MiB, Conexant, widescreen and AV conditions.

integrity: Each archive and its staging tree passed the tester bundle verifier; that establishes content integrity, not hardware compatibility.
privacy: Windows files, profile data, archive bytes, credentials and console preimages are excluded from this source receipt.
unavailable: No 640x480 E package is qualified by this receipt; the 1024x576 package has emulator-only evidence.
